Food with

SBK Concepts brings together two distinctive street food brands: Little Bao Boy and Kofuku.

01 / What we do

Made to
show up.

We believe food should be part of the atmosphere. From a quick bite at a market to feeding a crowd at an event, our concepts are built for flavour, energy and the joy of eating together.

Little Bao Boy brings the soft bun and bold fillings. Kofuku brings a Japanese street food point of view. Together, they give every occasion its own flavour.
